name: Shitrai
title: Overseer of cattle in the Sharon plain
summary: Shitrai from Sharon was one of King David's trusted officials responsible for the cattle grazing in the Sharon plain. He is mentioned in the list of David's administrators and officers in 1 Chronicles 27, as part of the well-organized administration of the kingdom's estates.

keyEvents.title: Shitrai as overseer of cattle in Sharon
keyEvents.description: Shitrai from Sharon was appointed to oversee the cattle grazing in the Sharon plain during King David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's administration
keyEvents.description: Shitrai was part of the extensive administrative structure that David established to manage the kingdom's estates and resources effectively.

keyEvents.title: David's management of the kingdom's wealth
keyEvents.description: Along with other administrators such as Shaphat, son of Adlai, who had charge of the cattle in the valleys, Shitrai ensured that the king's livestock were well cared for.

keyEvents.title: The Sharon plain as grazing land
keyEvents.description: Shitrai was responsible for the important grazing area in Sharon, a fertile coastal plain known for its rich vegetation and suitability as pasture for cattle.
